versions.change_summary: Initial direct-repair profile retained as the historical reference point.
Added observe-plan-act-verify guidance; later superseded after a correctness regression in the V1→V2 experiment.
Introduced targeted context and one-pass verification; retained as the V4/V4.1 comparison baseline.
Prompt-only success-stop hypothesis; Gate held the pre-experiment because successful runs still expanded after verification.

Bounded verification-stop profile plus a deterministic runtime stop after the exact verification command succeeds; the initial 8-Case promotion was confirmed on the 11-Case benchmark, pending human champion decision.
